message.reasoning:
We need to answer using policy excerpts. The question: "How do I get invoices sent to a shared finance inbox instead of just the admin's personal email?" This is about changing who receives invoice emails. The policy excerpts (DOC-004) provide steps: open Settings → Billing → Recipients and add or replace the billing contact email. Multiple recipients can be added, so a shared inbox can be added alongside rather than instead of an individual's address. Also note default is billing contact. Change applies to next invoice, not past.

Thus we can answer with those steps. No need to escalate. Provide short answer.

function.arguments: {"message":"Sure! By default invoice emails go to the workspace’s billing contact. To have them also go to a shared finance inbox, go to **Settings → Billing → Recipients** in your account. From there you can add the shared inbox address (or replace the existing contact). You can keep the admin’s personal address as well – multiple recipients are allowed. The new setting takes effect on the next invoice generated; past invoices won’t be resent."}

arguments.message: Sure! By default invoice emails go to the workspace’s billing contact. To have them also go to a shared finance inbox, go to **Settings → Billing → Recipients** in your account. From there you can add the shared inbox address (or replace the existing contact). You can keep the admin’s personal address as well – multiple recipients are allowed. The new setting takes effect on the next invoice generated; past invoices won’t be resent.
